original.target_description: Young et al., Study 1: original full text could not be acquired through permitted open routes; title and DOI verified in publisher/PubMed/OpenAlex metadata. No original-paper statistic taken from the replication paper.

replication.target_description: Wolf et al., Study 1, confirmatory linear mixed model of anger ratings: main effect of seven facial-redness levels, averaging two artificial male targets; neutral and angry expressions included, participant random intercept.

n.sample_role: Participants in the final analytic Study 1 sample; repeated anger ratings in the LMM.
n.exclusions: 68 recruited; 27 excluded for not using a computer; the 41st otherwise eligible participant excluded as preregistered. No missing-value or age exclusions.
n.quote:

notes: Original acquisition: DOI landing inaccessible; publisher PDF returned 403 (not retried); Unpaywall and OpenAlex reported no open full-text location; exact-title open-web searches found no accessible primary full text. Replication title verified against input and first page; acquired OSF primary file EMO_demandcharacteristics_v1.pdf via public API. Requested partial eta-squared and p are from the same confirmatory main-effect test.
